notes: Catalog code CH35. Verified against live catalog page. Total 120-122 units. B.S. requires 48+ upper-division units in the major and at least 6 upper-division Chemistry and Biochemistry Department courses. Physics: PHYS 1 or PHYS 2 series both acceptable (PHYS 1 recommended).

buckets.label: Calculus sequence
buckets.note: MATH 10A-B-C recommended, or 20A-B-C acceptable (choose one full sequence).

buckets.label: Physics
buckets.note: PHYS 1A-B-C recommended; PHYS 2A/2B and 2C or 2D also acceptable.

buckets.label: Physics Laboratory
buckets.note: PHYS 1AL-BL-CL accompanies PHYS 1 series; if PHYS 2 series taken, use PHYS 2BL/2CL/2DL instead.

buckets.label: Physical Chemistry
buckets.note: Two quarters of physical chemistry (CHEM 126A-B recommended; CHEM 130-131-132 acceptable).

buckets.label: Advanced Laboratory (choose 1)
buckets.note: Choose 1 to complete the three-course advanced-lab requirement.

buckets.label: Pharmacology restricted elective
buckets.note: One PHARM restricted chemistry elective from Pharmacology and Toxicology (118), Medicinal Chemistry (167), or Drug Synthesis and Design (168).

buckets.label: Restricted electives
buckets.note: Choose 2 from the listed options (distinct from the pharmacology restricted elective). Specific biology options not fully line-verified; confirm with department.

buckets.label: Chemistry/Biology elective
buckets.note: One upper-division Chemistry and Biochemistry Department course, or an approved upper-division physiology/anatomy/microbiology/human-behavior course from the School of Biological Sciences.
